newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-SUSPENDED BANS FOR CROFT AND ILOTT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUSPENDED BANS FOR CROFT AND ILOTT.

text.p: Glamorgan off-spinner Robert Croft and Essex paceman Mark Ilott were handed two-match suspended bans on Tuesday after clashing in a tense NatWest Trophy semifinal last week.

England player Croft and Ilott were involved in a shoving match in the middle of the pitch after Ilott successfully appealed against the light at Chelmsford last Tuesday. Essex went on to win by one wicket the following day.

Both players were fined 1,000 pounds ($1,600) by their counties following the incident and the England and Wales Cricket Board hit the pair with two-match bans from the knockout competition starting next year, but suspended for two years.
